title: AceAction-5M: Hierarchical Goals for Generalist Action Learning Across 3D Game Worlds
abstract: arXiv:2611.04241v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Video games provide a practical setting for collecting vision-language-action (VLA) data, whose acquisition in physical environments is costly. Existing datasets, however, remain limited by restricted game coverage, sparse language supervision, or temporal hierarchies that do not necessarily reflect changes in task objectives. We introduce AceAction, a dataset of human gameplay across multiple 3D games for learning skill composition and subgoal transitions. AceAction organizes demonstrations around complete tasks, linking overall instructions, ordered subgoals, and local skill instructions to temporally aligned visual observations and keyboard-and-mouse actions. To construct these annotations, we develop a vision-language model pipeline that identifies subgoals from changes in objectives or interaction targets, anchors navigation goals to visually recognizable waypoints, and composes adjacent subgoals into task instructions. translated_title: AceAction-5M：面向3D游戏世界中通用智能体动作学习的分层目标
translated_abstract: 电子游戏为收集视觉-语言-动作（VLA）数据提供了一个实用的场景，因为在物理环境中获取这类数据的成本高昂。然而，现有数据集仍然受限于游戏覆盖范围有限、语言监督稀疏，或者其时间层级结构不一定反映任务目标的变化。我们推出了AceAction，这是一个跨越多款3D游戏的人类游戏玩法数据集，用于学习技能组合与子目标转换。AceAction围绕完整任务来组织演示数据，将总体指令、有序的子目标以及局部技能指令与时序对齐的视觉观察和键盘鼠标动作相链接。为了构建这些标注，我们开发了一个视觉-语言模型流水线，该流水线从目标或交互对象的变化中识别子目标，将导航目标锚定到视觉上可识别的路标点，并将相邻的子目标组合成任务指令。所得的数据……
tldr: 提出了AceAction数据集，收集跨多款3D游戏的人类游戏玩法，并通过视觉-语言模型流水线自动标注总体任务指令、有序子目标与局部技能指令的分层结构，用于通用智能体的技能组合与子目标转换学习。
en_tdlr: AceAction is a human gameplay dataset spanning multiple 3D games, with a vision-language model pipeline that automatically annotates hierarchical goals—overall task instructions, ordered subgoals, and local skill instructions—to enable generalist learning of skill composition and subgoal transitions.
